subject: Any volunteers to test upcoming GGIR feature? (parallel GGIR)

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Any volunteers to test upcoming GGIR feature? (parallel GGIR)
parts:
I could use some testers for a new GGIR functionality I am working on.
This functionality will make GGIR parts 2, 3 and 5 able to process multiple files in parallel on any desktop/laptop machine with at least 4 CPU cores.

It seems to work on my laptop, but it would be great if others could also test it.

Instructions:

1. Install the development version of GGIR that has this new feature with the two lines of code below. Notice that you will also need to install R package "devtools" if you do not have it yet. 

library(devtools)
install_github("wadpac/GGIR",ref="issue194_parallel")
2. Install R packages: "foreach" and "doParallel".
3. Re-start R(Studio)
4. Try to run your g.shell.GGIR call as you normally do for parts 2, 3 and 5 in a data sets of at least a dozen files.

If all goes well this should go (a lot) faster than before. How much faster depends on your machine. Please let me know if it generates any errors or if the speed does not go up.

I did not implement the parallel processing for parts 1 and 4 (yet), because for part 1 this is currently too tricky and for part 4 I think it is less relevant because part 4 is already fast.

Best wishes, Vincent
